metadata.description: Chwezi skill engines — a suite of independent, standalone-installable domain engines for consulting, requirements, design, research, and infrastructure work, plus the coordination package that routes across them. Install only what you need: each plugin below installs fully on its own.

plugins.name: chwezi-suite
plugins.description: Coordination core: routes requests to the correct engine, maintains and validates local engine checkouts (engine-orchestrator, engine-maintainer, engine-validator agents). Optional — no other Chwezi plugin depends on it.
